title: Is There a Warranty on Handmade Solid Wood Furniture? What WRYDECO Covers
meta_description: Is there a warranty on handmade solid wood furniture? Learn about WRYDECO's 1-year limited warranty, material defect coverage, joinery protection, and care rules.
body_html:
Investing in artisan-crafted solid hardwood furniture represents a commitment to enduring quality, natural warmth, and timeless design. Unlike disposable flat-pack furniture manufactured from glued particleboard, handcrafted solid wood is built to last for generations. Nevertheless, thoughtful homeowners rightfully seek clear warranty protection to safeguard their investment against unforeseen defects.

WRYDECO provides a comprehensive 1-year limited warranty across all furniture product categories, effective from the verified date of delivery. This warranty specifically protects your purchase against manufacturing defects in materials and artisanal joinery under normal indoor residential use. In addition, our separate 30-calendar-day return policy covers items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect due to a fulfillment error, providing store-paid return shipping and dedicated customer service support.

What does WRYDECO's 1-year limited warranty cover on handcrafted furniture?

WRYDECO warrants that all of our furniture pieces are free from defects in materials and craftsmanship for a period of one year from the date of carrier delivery. Because each piece is individually crafted by master artisans in Vietnam, our quality assurance protocols ensure high standards of timber selection and joinery integrity.

Under this 1-year limited warranty, if a product is determined to possess defects resulting from manufacturing issues, WRYDECO will, at its sole discretion, repair or replace the defective parts. Coverage includes:

  • Structural failure of internal mortise, tenon, dowel, or concealed mechanical joinery under normal residential loads.
  • Delamination or splitting of laminated solid timber blanks caused by defective adhesive bonding during workshop fabrication.
  • Defective mounting bracket weldments or hardware fittings supplied with the unit.
  • Severe timber checking or structural warping present at the time of initial delivery that impairs functional stability.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860579418.jpg]

Keep these four key aspects of warranty coverage in mind:

  • The 1-year warranty begins on the date the delivery carrier records arrival at your address.
  • Warranty coverage applies exclusively to the original purchaser and residential installation address.
  • Repair or modular component replacement is prioritized to restore full structural integrity without wasteful freight disposal.
  • Contact WRYDECO support at support@wrydeco.com with clear photographs and your order number to initiate an evaluation.

What situations, user actions, and environmental conditions are excluded from warranty coverage?

While solid timber possesses remarkable tensile strength and durability, it remains an organic natural material that responds dynamically to its ambient environment. To maintain clarity, our warranty policy explicitly defines scenarios that fall outside limited warranty coverage.

Specifically, the warranty does not cover:

  • Normal wear and tear, including minor surface scuffs, shallow dents, softened edges, or finish patina developed through daily residential living.
  • Accidental damage, negligence, or physical abuse, including cuts, burns, chemical spills, impact fractures, or pet-related scratches.
  • Exposure to harsh cleaning chemicals, abrasive scouring powders, silicone furniture polishes, or ammonia-based window sprays.
  • Extreme environmental exposure, including placement directly adjacent to active heat registers, radiator pipes, direct unshaded sunlight, or outdoor weather.
  • Humidity-induced damage resulting from ambient room relative humidity falling outside the recommended 40% to 60% range.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860612186_2fa155fa-6aa5-4b78-bf0e-03c11df99628.jpg]

Protect your warranty eligibility with these four operational guidelines:

  • Never use abrasive kitchen sponges or chemical solvent sprays on hand-rubbed oil finishes.
  • Maintain room ambient humidity between 40% and 60% year-round using standard residential humidifiers or dehumidifiers.
  • Position furniture at least 24 inches away from forced-air heating vents and wood-burning stoves.
  • Use protective coasters, trivets, and felt pads under heavy ceramic stoneware and hot beverage mugs.

How does natural seasonal timber movement differ from structural manufacturing defects?

Understanding the organic nature of solid hardwood prevents confusing natural seasonal wood behavior with manufacturing flaws. Solid timber is hygroscopic, meaning wood cells absorb moisture during humid summer months and release moisture during dry, heated winter months.

Microscopic expansion and contraction across timber grain lines is a normal characteristic of authentic solid wood. During winter, hairline expansion gaps of less than 1 millimeter may appear at joint intersections, only to close smoothly as springtime humidity returns. These seasonal shifts do not compromise structural stability. In contrast, a genuine manufacturing defect involves deep timber fractures that sever continuous wood grain, sheared joinery dowels, or warping exceeding 1/4 inch per linear foot that prevents shelf leveling.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860907098.jpg]

Evaluate timber behavior against these four diagnostic checkpoints:

  • Hairline seasonal breathing at joint seams is a natural characteristic of living solid timber.
  • Structural manufacturing defects involve broken wood fibers, detached joints, or compromised load capacity.
  • Penetrating plant-based hardwax oil finishes allow timber to breathe naturally without synthetic plastic peeling.
  • Consult WRYDECO customer support if you notice timber movement that exceeds normal seasonal tolerances.

What daily and seasonal care habits preserve solid timber furniture for decades?

Proper daily maintenance ensures your solid wood furniture looks stunning for generations while preserving its warranty protection. Because WRYDECO hand-finishes each piece with zero-VOC, plant-based hardwax oils that penetrate deep into the timber rather than creating a brittle surface plastic film, ongoing care is remarkably simple.

For daily cleaning, simply wipe down surfaces with a soft, clean, dry or lightly dampened microfiber cloth. Avoid commercial aerosol polishes, lemon oils containing petroleum distillates, and abrasive scouring pads. Every 6 to 12 months, or whenever timber surfaces begin to appear dry from seasonal heating, reapply a thin coat of natural hardwax oil using a soft lint-free cotton cloth. Buff lightly along the direction of the wood grain after 15 minutes to restore a rich, silky luster and renew surface moisture resistance.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305861234778.jpg]

Follow these four core maintenance rules:

  • Dust regularly with a clean, dry microfiber cloth without chemical polishing sprays.
  • Reapply natural hardwax oil every 6 to 12 months to nourish timber fibers and restore sheen.
  • Maintain indoor relative humidity between 40% and 60% across all seasons.
  • Remember our 6-hour golden cancellation window allows 100% free changes before crafting commences.

Worked example: submitting a verified warranty claim for a hairline joinery issue

To see how WRYDECO resolves genuine warranty issues under our 1-year limited warranty, consider this scenario involving a customer who ordered a 60"W x 60"H x 10"D compare specifications for Layered Corner Tree Bookshelf for Nursery ($2,391.00 to $4,591.00):

  • Month 7: Customer notices a looseness in the joint connection between Branch Limb 2 and the central trunk spine. Upon inspection, an internal steel mounting dowel appears slightly out of alignment, causing the shelf perch to wobble under moderate book weight.
  • Day 1: Customer takes three clear photographs: one wide shot of the assembled corner shelf, one medium shot showing the sagging limb, and one close-up photograph showing the gap at the internal joint dowel. Customer emails support@wrydeco.com with order details and photos.
  • Day 2: WRYDECO engineering team reviews the photo evidence, confirms a manufacturing tolerance defect in the internal dowel sleeve, and approves warranty replacement of Branch Limb 2 under the 1-year limited warranty.
  • Day 14: A new, precision-drilled replacement Branch Limb 2 arrives via express shipping at zero cost to the customer, complete with new mounting bolts and step-by-step reattachment instructions.
  • Day 15: Customer replaces the limb in 15 minutes, restoring the corner bookshelf to perfect structural stability and continuing decades of worry-free enjoyment.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does WRYDECO offer a lifetime or 10-year warranty?

No. WRYDECO offers a 1-year limited warranty from the date of delivery covering defects in materials and craftsmanship under normal indoor residential use. We do not claim lifetime, 5-year, or 10-year structural warranties.

What is the difference between the 30-day return policy and the 1-year warranty?

Our 30-calendar-day return policy covers items that arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect due to freight transit or fulfillment errors, providing store-paid return shipping. The 1-year limited warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials or joinery that emerge during normal residential use throughout your first year of ownership.

Are change-of-mind returns covered under the warranty?

No. WRYDECO handcrafted furniture pieces are made to order; returns for change of mind, personal preference, or customer measurement error are not accepted under warranty or return policies.

How do I submit a warranty claim if I discover an issue?

Email our customer support team at support@wrydeco.com with your original order number, delivery date, a clear written description of the issue, and well-lit photographs showing the complete unit and close-up views of the defect. Our team responds within 1 to 2 business days.
